query:
SELECT 
  status,
  COUNT(*) as count,
  ROUND(AVG(TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, created_at, COALESCE(updated_at, NOW()))), 1) as avg_hours_in_status,
  MIN(TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, created_at, COALESCE(updated_at, NOW()))) as min_hours,
  MAX(TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, created_at, COALESCE(updated_at, NOW()))) as max_hours,
  SUM(CASE WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, created_at, NOW()) > 24 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as stalled_24h,
  SUM(CASE WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, created_at, NOW()) > 72 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as stalled_72h
FROM claims
GROUP BY status
ORDER BY count DESC;
